ideas.title: Investigating the Feeding Our Future Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future scandal and the misuse of state funds in the program.
questions: What was the extent of the fraud in the Feeding Our Future program?
How did the fraud occur and who was involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread fraud and corruption in state programs. By following the money and investigating the program, we can uncover the truth and hold those responsible accountable.
